summary.text: Elizabeth "Spencer" Wetmore is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives for District 115 in Charleston County.
She was elected in a special election on August 11, 2020, to fill the unexpired term of Peter M. McCoy Jr., who resigned.

paragraphs.text: Wetmore was born on April 22, 1983, in Charleston, and is an attorney.
Her official page lists an A.B. from Princeton University in 2005 and a J.D. from Vanderbilt University School of Law in 2010.
She was an assistant solicitor in Charleston County from 2010 to 2014 and city administrator of Folly Beach from 2014 to 2020.
She serves on the House Judiciary and Rules committees.
